component.name: Melyar
component.summary: Ultra-lightweight native YouTube Music desktop client

description.p: Melyar is a Linux-first, local-first desktop music client for YouTube Music. It combines a fast Rust core, a native Qt/C++ shell, and a polished React + TypeScript interface to deliver a clean, responsive listening experience without the overhead of heavier desktop frameworks.

ul.li: Search, browse, and play YouTube Music content
Playback with libmpv and gapless streaming behavior
Queue management, shuffle, repeat, volume, and seek controls
Synced LRC lyrics with plain-text fallback
Favorites, history, albums, artists, and library views
Library import from Spotify export, JSON or CSV
Ten band graphic equaliser (31 Hz - 16 kHz)
Liquid Glass-inspired interface with light/dark theming
Fifteen interface languages, switched at runtime
Native Linux media integration via MPRIS and Unix socket IPC

description.p: Melyar is built for people who want a music player that feels native on Linux — small runtime footprint, fast startup, and deep desktop integration with MPRIS and Waybar.
